mapper.sql: select r.result_id, r.schedule_id, r.user_id, r.login_name, u.user_name, r.dept_id, d.dept_name, r.work_date, r.shift_id, sh.shift_name, r.rest_type, r.attendance_status, r.exception_type, r.expected_in_time, r.expected_out_time, r.actual_in_time, r.actual_out_time, r.punch_count, r.late_flag, r.early_flag, r.miss_card_flag, r.absent_flag, r.expected_minutes, r.actual_minutes, seg.segment_summary, seg.segment1_in_display, seg.segment1_out_display, seg.segment1_status, seg.segment2_in_display, seg.segment2_out_display, seg.segment2_status, seg.segment3_in_display, seg.segment3_out_display, seg.segment3_status, r.data_source, r.remark from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id left join hr_shift sh on sh.shift_id = r.shift_id left join ( select result_id, group_concat( concat( segment_name, '(', case segment_status when 'NORMAL' then 'NORMAL' when 'PENDING_CLOCK' then 'PENDING' when 'MISS_CARD' then 'MISS_CARD' when 'LATE' then 'LATE' when 'EARLY' then 'EARLY' when 'LATE_EARLY' then 'LATE_EARLY' when 'ABSENT' then 'ABSENT' else segment_status end, ' ', ifnull(date_format(actual_in_time, '%H:%i'), '-'), '/', ifnull(date_format(actual_out_time, '%H:%i'), '-'), ')' ) order by segment_no separator '; ' ) as segment_summary, max(case when segment_no = 1 then ifnull(date_format(actual_in_time, '%H:%i'), '-') end) as segment1_in_display, max(case when segment_no = 1 then ifnull(date_format(actual_out_time, '%H:%i'), '-') end) as segment1_out_display, max(case when segment_no = 1 then segment_status end) as segment1_status, max(case when segment_no = 2 then ifnull(date_format(actual_in_time, '%H:%i'), '-') end) as segment2_in_display, max(case when segment_no = 2 then ifnull(date_format(actual_out_time, '%H:%i'), '-') end) as segment2_out_display, max(case when segment_no = 2 then segment_status end) as segment2_status, max(case when segment_no = 3 then ifnull(date_format(actual_in_time, '%H:%i'), '-') end) as segment3_in_display, max(case when segment_no = 3 then ifnull(date_format(actual_out_time, '%H:%i'), '-') end) as segment3_out_display, max(case when segment_no = 3 then segment_status end) as segment3_status from hr_attendance_result_segment group by result_id ) seg on seg.result_id = r.result_id
mapper.insert: insert into hr_attendance_result( schedule_id, user_id, login_name, dept_id, work_date, shift_id, rest_type, attendance_status, exception_type, expected_in_time, expected_out_time, actual_in_time, actual_out_time, punch_count, late_flag, early_flag, miss_card_flag, absent_flag, expected_minutes, actual_minutes, data_source, remark, create_by, create_time ) values( #{scheduleId}, #{userId}, #{loginName}, #{deptId}, #{workDate}, #{shiftId}, #{restType}, #{attendanceStatus}, #{exceptionType}, #{expectedInTime}, #{expectedOutTime}, #{actualInTime}, #{actualOutTime}, #{punchCount}, #{lateFlag}, #{earlyFlag}, #{missCardFlag}, #{absentFlag}, #{expectedMinutes}, #{actualMinutes}, #{dataSource}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

insert into hr_attendance_exception(user_id, work_date, exception_type, exception_detail, create_by, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{workDate}, #{exceptionType}, #{exceptionDetail}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select d.dept_name, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as needDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status in ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY', 'LATE_EARLY', 'MISS_CARD') then 1 else 0 end) as workDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status = 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as restDays, sum(case when r.late_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as lateCount, sum(case when r.early_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as earlyCount, sum(case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as missCardCount, sum(case when r.absent_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as absentCount, sum(r.actual_minutes) as actualMinutes from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y-%m') = #{monthStr} and r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.user_id = #{userId} group by r.dept_id, d.dept_name order by r.dept_id

select r.login_name, u.user_name, d.dept_name, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as needDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status in ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY', 'LATE_EARLY', 'MISS_CARD') then 1 else 0 end) as workDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status = 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as restDays, sum(case when r.late_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as lateCount, sum(case when r.early_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as earlyCount, sum(case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as missCardCount, sum(case when r.absent_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as absentCount, sum(r.actual_minutes) as actualMinutes from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y-%m') = #{monthStr} and r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.user_id = #{userId} group by r.user_id, r.login_name, u.user_name, d.dept_name order by r.login_name asc

select d.dept_name, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as needDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status in ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY', 'LATE_EARLY', 'MISS_CARD') then 1 else 0 end) as workDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status = 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as restDays, sum(case when r.late_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as lateCount, sum(case when r.early_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as earlyCount, sum(case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as missCardCount, sum(case when r.absent_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as absentCount, sum(r.actual_minutes) as actualMinutes from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y') = #{yearStr} and r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.user_id = #{userId} group by r.dept_id, d.dept_name order by r.dept_id

select r.login_name, u.user_name, d.dept_name, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as needDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status in ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY', 'LATE_EARLY', 'MISS_CARD') then 1 else 0 end) as workDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status = 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as restDays, sum(case when r.late_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as lateCount, sum(case when r.early_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as earlyCount, sum(case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as missCardCount, sum(case when r.absent_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as absentCount, sum(r.actual_minutes) as actualMinutes from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y') = #{yearStr} and r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.user_id = #{userId} group by r.user_id, r.login_name, u.user_name, d.dept_name order by r.login_name asc

select ifnull(r.dept_id, 0) as deptId, ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') as deptName, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as needDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status in ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY', 'LATE_EARLY', 'MISS_CARD') then 1 else 0 end) as workDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status = 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as restDays, count(distinct case when r.late_flag = '1' then r.user_id end) as lateUserCount, count(distinct case when r.early_flag = '1' then r.user_id end) as earlyUserCount, count(distinct case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then r.user_id end) as missCardUserCount, count(distinct case when r.absent_flag = '1' then r.user_id end) as absentUserCount from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} and r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.login_name like concat('%', #{loginName}, '%')
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user su where su.user_id = r.user_id and su.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') )
group by ifnull(r.dept_id, 0), ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') order by ifnull(r.dept_id, 0)

select r.user_id as userId, r.login_name as loginName, ifnull(u.user_name, '-') as userName, ifnull(r.dept_id, 0) as deptId, ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') as deptName, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as needDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status in ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY', 'LATE_EARLY', 'MISS_CARD') then 1 else 0 end) as workDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status = 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as restDays, sum(case when r.late_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as lateCount, sum(case when r.early_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as earlyCount, sum(case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as missCardCount, sum(case when r.absent_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as absentCount, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then ifnull(r.actual_minutes, 0) else 0 end) as actualMinutes from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} and r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.login_name like concat('%', #{loginName}, '%') and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') group by r.user_id, r.login_name, u.user_name, r.dept_id, d.dept_name order by r.login_name asc

select ifnull(r.dept_id, 0) as deptId, ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') as deptName, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as needDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status in ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY', 'LATE_EARLY', 'MISS_CARD') then 1 else 0 end) as workDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status = 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as restDays, count(distinct case when r.late_flag = '1' then r.user_id end) as lateUserCount, count(distinct case when r.early_flag = '1' then r.user_id end) as earlyUserCount, count(distinct case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then r.user_id end) as missCardUserCount, count(distinct case when r.absent_flag = '1' then r.user_id end) as absentUserCount from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y') = #{year} and r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.login_name like concat('%', #{loginName}, '%')
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user su where su.user_id = r.user_id and su.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') )
group by ifnull(r.dept_id, 0), ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') order by ifnull(r.dept_id, 0)

select r.user_id as userId, r.login_name as loginName, ifnull(u.user_name, '-') as userName, ifnull(r.dept_id, 0) as deptId, ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') as deptName, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as needDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status in ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY', 'LATE_EARLY', 'MISS_CARD') then 1 else 0 end) as workDays, sum(case when r.attendance_status = 'REST' then 1 else 0 end) as restDays, sum(case when r.late_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as lateCount, sum(case when r.early_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as earlyCount, sum(case when r.miss_card_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as missCardCount, sum(case when r.absent_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as absentCount, sum(case when r.attendance_status <> 'REST' then ifnull(r.actual_minutes, 0) else 0 end) as actualMinutes from hr_attendance_result r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where date_format(r.work_date, '%Y') = #{year} and r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.login_name like concat('%', #{loginName}, '%') and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') group by r.user_id, r.login_name, u.user_name, r.dept_id, d.dept_name order by r.login_name asc
